run_adsorbml_calculate: run the AdsorbMLRunner calculate method to find global minima adsorption energy for a chunk of structures
init_adsorbml_runner: create an AdsorbMLRunner with an ASE calculator, input data path, and relaxation parameters like fmax and steps
write_adsorbml_results: write AdsorbML calculation results to a compressed JSON file using the write_results method
review_adsorbml_runner_class: review the AdsorbMLRunner class that extends CalculateRunner to handle atomic structure relaxation and adsorption energy calculations
refactor_adsorbml_optimizer: refactor the AdsorbMLRunner to use a different ASE optimizer class instead of the default LBFGS
